title: NativeProjection.v1
description: One same-shape output Baltor returns to the customer's own system. The projection is built per output_mode against a NativeShapeContract: JSON keeps the same keys/nesting, CSV the same columns/order/delimiter/newline, Markdown the original unchanged (+ sidecar) or annotated. same_schema asserts the output is schema-identical to the source. source_hash binds the projection to the exact input bytes; native_output_ref points to the produced bytes. A projection NEVER overwrites the original and only carries VERIFIED value changes (each recorded in a NativeDiff). Lossless distillation: a projection is a view, never a replacement.
